title: Atlas DataFlow Predict View Customization
description: Companion contract defining the safe customization metadata surface for predict views. Governs presentation-only fields: view-level copy, field-level display hints, and group definitions. Does not carry validation rules, inference behavior, domain constraints, or model configuration. Canonical runtime validation and input semantics remain owned by canonical dataset contracts. Project Spec S0250: field_hints entries reference a public input field -- a scalar public-contract v1 feature name, or a public-contract v2 univariate-forecasting history-series field name (time-index or target). The governed input field set for a given bound view is resolved externally by the compatibility validator (registry/predict_view_customization_validate.py), never by this schema.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this predict view customization schema structure in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH format.

view_id.description: Stable predict view identifier this customization applies to. Must match a view_id in the predict view registry. It is not a dataset identifier, route alias, or runtime contract name.

dataset_slug.description: Optional associated dataset slug for traceability. When provided, must match the dataset_slug of the bound predict view.

field_hints.description: Optional array of per-field presentation hints. Each hint references a field by its public input field name (a scalar public-contract v1 feature name, or a public-contract v2 history-series time-index/target field name) and provides presentation-only metadata. Field names must correspond to a public input field for the bound dataset. No domain bounds or validation rules may be included. For a public-contract v2 univariate-forecasting view, neither history-series field may be hidden or grouped -- both are always required and ungrouped.

groups.description: Optional array of section or group definitions for organizing fields in the prediction experience. Groups are presentation metadata only and must not control validation, inference order, or model behavior. For a public-contract v2 univariate-forecasting view, this array must be empty or absent -- history-series customization never introduces groups.

_example_note.description: Optional annotation for example or demonstration artifacts only. Omit in production customization records.

view_copy.description: Optional view-level presentation copy. All fields are presentation text only and must not carry validation rules, inference hints, or business logic.

heading.description: Optional public-safe heading for the prediction experience, if different from the predict view title.

description.description: Optional public-safe description of this prediction experience's purpose.

usage_guidance.description: Optional public-safe contextual guidance for users. Must not contain executable routing, validation rules, or business logic.

submit_button_label.description: Optional curated label for this view's prediction submit action. Public-safe presentation copy only -- must not carry validation rules, routing, scripts, HTML, or model behavior. This is the canonical owner of submit-action copy; contracts/dataset-public-profile.schema.json's result_card.submit_button_label is a deprecated, read-only legacy fallback only.

field_hint.description: Presentation hint for a single public input field. field_name must reference a field name from the public contract projection for the bound dataset -- a scalar v1 feature name, or a v2 history-series time-index/target field name. No domain bounds, accepted value lists, or validation rules may be included.

field_name.description: Name of the public input field this hint applies to. Must match a feature name (v1) or history-series time-index/target field name (v2) in the public contract projection for the bound dataset.

display_label.description: Optional alternative display label for the field in this view context. Does not replace or redefine the canonical public contract label.

explanatory_copy.description: Optional explanatory text for the field in this view context. Must not contain validation rules, accepted value lists, or domain constraints.

display_order_hint.description: Optional integer hint for field display ordering within this view. This is a presentation hint only and does not redefine the canonical display_order in the public contract.

group.description: Optional group_id associating this field with a group defined in the groups array.

hidden.description: Optional visibility hint. When true, the renderer omits this field's input from the form. Applies only to rendering; does not alter validation semantics or inference payload schema. Must not be true for required fields (optional: false in the public contract).

group_definition.description: Definition of a section or group for organizing fields in the prediction experience. Groups are presentation metadata only and must not encode validation logic or inference behavior.

group_id.description: Stable identifier for this group, referenced by field_hints.group.

label.description: Public-safe display label for the group.

description.description: Optional public-safe description of the group's purpose.

contract_precedence.description: Explicit schema-level contract precedence declaration. These constants prevent customization metadata from becoming a second contract system.

canonical_contracts_are_source_of_truth.description: Must be true. Runtime validation and input semantics remain owned by canonical dataset contracts.

customization_defines_runtime_validation.description: Must be false. Customization metadata does not define, extend, or override inference validation rules.

customization_duplicates_contract.description: Must be false. Customization metadata does not duplicate canonical runtime or public contracts.
